name: Manastorm: Abyssal Covenant on a party member survives a stage transfer with its remaining time (#12427)
contract: Issue #12427. Abyssal Covenant 500751 is a single-target aura (DurationIndex 30 = 1800000 ms) that a Cultist
casts on an ally; its apply hook casts Abyssal Covenant Passive 300295 on the caster. A stage transfer
teleports members one by one, and Unit::RemoveFromWorld runs RemoveNotOwnSingleTargetAuras on whichever of
the caster or the target leaves first, so the covenant was gone on the next floor. The maintainer decided the
covenant must remain. PrepareStageMemberTransfer now records each single-target positive aura linking two run
members and RestoreStageLinks re-applies it once both members are on the new floor, keeping the remaining
time instead of refreshing it. The member must hold the leader's covenant on the next floor with less than
the full 1800000 ms left, and the leader must hold 300295 again.

steps.label: member joins the leader's group so both are run members
CONTROL: the leader entered a private Manastorm instance
CONTROL: the member was brought into the same run
the Cultist leader binds the member with Abyssal Covenant
SETUP: the member holds the leader's Abyssal Covenant
SETUP: the covenant's apply hook gave the leader Abyssal Covenant Passive
match the native phase 1 Manastorm room
only the leader goes to Taragaman
CONTROL: the leader left the entrance protection at the boss
CONTROL: the floor committed and the run advanced, restoring entrance protection
CONTROL: the member moved with the run to the next floor
the member still holds the leader's Abyssal Covenant on the next floor
the covenant kept its remaining time instead of refreshing to the full 1800000 ms
the leader holds Abyssal Covenant Passive again on the next floor
